commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: I have drawn each route as we found it. The marks show the attacks we had to pass.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: A road map is useful. Knowing where it nearly killed you is better.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: May I practice the routes too?

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Yes. On the record. No one goes back into danger just to prove the first crossing counted.
The yard survey lies flat beneath the lamps. Its routes can be studied again without closing the real gate.
